{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the response rate calculation
# For each site, compute: (responded == 1) / total count
site_response_rate = trial_df.groupby('site').agg(
    total_patients=('responded', 'size'),
    responded_count=('responded', 'sum'),
    response_rate=('responded', 'mean')
).round(4)

print("Detailed response rate by site:\n", site_response_rate)"}
